answer: Every claim climbs the comet of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the quill re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the glacier of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, expired if not renewed by fresh work, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
